当应用在运行过程中需要向用户发送本地通知时使用本Kit
典型场景包括即时消息通知、文件下载/上传进度显示、运动数据更新、支付结果通知等
开发者需要先请求通知授权，然后构造NotificationRequest对象发布通知
当需要实现跨设备通知协同或通知订阅扩展时也可使用本Kit
跨设备协同通知可以让通知在手机、手表、平板等设备间同步，并通过appMessageId实现去重
通知订阅扩展能力让三方应用可以接收和处理系统通知
实现消息到达时在状态栏弹出提醒 / Show a status bar alert when a message arrives
发送下载任务的前台服务通知并实时更新进度 / Send a foreground service notification and update progress in real time
为不同消息类型创建并管理通知渠道 / Create and manage notification channels for different message types
点击通知跳转到指定页面并携带参数 / Open a specific page with parameters when a notification is tapped
请求通知权限并处理用户拒绝后的降级提示 / Request notification permission and handle fallback when the user denies it
更新同一条通知内容避免重复堆叠 / Update the same notification to avoid duplicate stacking
清除指定通知或一键清空全部通知 / Remove a specific notification or clear all notifications
设置应用图标角标显示未读消息数量 / Set the app icon badge to show unread message counts
接收系统通知变化并监听通知发布或移除事件 / Listen for system notification posted and removed events
实现跨设备同步通知并避免多端重复提醒 / Sync notifications across devices and avoid duplicate alerts
发布带操作按钮的通知以支持快速处理 / Publish a notification with action buttons for quick handling
按会话或业务分组显示多条通知 / Group multiple notifications by conversation or business type
do_not_use_when: 应用需要在进程终止、未运行或设备离线时由云侧下发通知，此时应使用 push-kit / The app needs cloud-delivered notifications when the process is terminated, not running, or the device is offline; use push-kit instead
需求是服务端远程推送到用户设备，而不是应用运行时发布本地通知，此时应使用 push-kit / The requirement is server-side remote push to user devices rather than app-runtime local notifications; use push-kit instead

需求是展示持续更新的实时卡片或锁屏/桌面实时视图，而非标准通知栏通知，此时应使用 live-view-kit / The goal is to show continuously updating live cards or lock-screen/home-screen live views rather than standard notification-center notifications; use live-view-kit instead

需要长时间、高频率地动态展示状态且强调沉浸式实时呈现，不适合普通通知样式，此时应使用 live-view-kit / The feature needs long-running, high-frequency dynamic status presentation with immersive real-time display, which is not suited to ordinary notifications; use live-view-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已引入并可使用 Notification Kit 相关 SDK 接口 / The project has the Notification Kit SDK APIs available
应用已按场景完成通知授权请求，且用户未关闭应用通知开关 / Notification permission has been requested as needed, and the user has not disabled the app's notification switch
若通知需点击跳转或触发行为，相关 WantAgent 目标能力已正确声明并可被拉起 / If the notification should open a target or trigger an action, the corresponding WantAgent target ability is properly declared and launchable
inputs: 通知内容数据（标题、正文、进度、多行文本等） / Notification content data (title, body, progress, multiline text, etc.)
通知标识信息（notificationId、slot/channel、appMessageId等） / Notification identifier data (notificationId, slot/channel, appMessageId, etc.)
通知点击行为对应的WantAgent对象 / WantAgent object for notification click action

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建或填充用于发布/更新通知的 NotificationRequest 及其关键内容字段 / The code creates or populates a NotificationRequest with the key content fields for publishing/updating a notification
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show a NotificationRequest (or equivalent notification payload object) being created or updated with meaningful notification content such as title, text, multiline text, or progress?

postconditions.statement: 代码中已调用 Notification Kit 的通知发布、更新或取消相关接口以完成目标操作 / The code calls Notification Kit APIs to publish, update, or cancel the notification as intended
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include a concrete Notification Kit API call that publishes, updates, or cancels a notification, matching the requested behavior?

postconditions.statement: 若需求包含点击通知行为，代码已将 WantAgent 绑定到通知配置中 / If click behavior is required, the code attaches a WantAgent to the notification configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested feature includes tapping the notification to open something or trigger an action, does the edit set attach a WantAgent (or equivalent action intent) to the notification?
